svg.title: Akhtael Hunting Yacht - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 12-13, PDF 13-14. Combined aligned decks preserve forked forward hull, broad curved shoulders and separated rear drive legs. Lower deck bridge projects into the deeper upper-deck forward slot, so the combined notch is shallower than upper deck alone. Relative alignment uses matching beam and centreline; interpretation disclosed. Illustration corroborates forward fork and twin stern legs. Interior docking bay stays solid where enclosed.
